title: R&M wave 3b - additional DOC zones found in the full 164-row raw log (beyond the first 3 spotted in the pivot summary)
provider_modules_basis: No new provider-level module enablement in this wave.
notes: Adds zones to the already-seeded Department of Conservation organization (matched by name, existing org row untouched). Full CSV export of the raw DOC log sheet (164 rows) revealed 5 more distinct real Location values beyond the 3 already seeded in wave 3: Flora Carpark, Wairoa Gorge, Tennyson Inlet, Paton Rd (Patons Rock), St Arnaud. Geocoded live via linz-lookup. Some other Location values in the raw data (blank, 'E', 'N/A', 'Enter', 'West Coast', 'Tasman', 'Whataroa') were judged too vague/junk/geographically-implausible to seed as zones and are intentionally excluded — rows referencing them will be skipped by the Phase 2 importer rather than force-placed.
